scenario.title: Battle of Pindus
intro.text:
BATTLE OF PINDUS - 3 NOV 1940

Pindus Mountains, Epirus

In your defense sector an Italian Division tries to advance on the strategic mountain pass at the town of Metsovo and threatens to cut off our supply routes and to separate our troops in Epirus and in Macedonia. Stop the attack and chase away the Italian troops from the Pindus Mountains! Our Cavalry Division will try to surround the enemy on their right flank and encircle the Italians together with your troops.

GOAL Capture all VH!

NOTE The unit occupying the town Vovousa, gets the chance of a Leader!
player.speaker: Commander
line.scene-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.scene-0.text: Captain, that mule has the last two boxes for Vovousa. If the path washes out again, the company up there fights with what is already in its pouches.
line.scene-1.speaker: Konstantinos Davakis
line.scene-1.text: Then stop calling it a path and put six men on it with shovels. The Julia Division is not waiting for the rain to finish.
line.scene-2.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.scene-2.text: Italian patrols have found three gaps since dawn. We can fill them, but only by taking the battalion that has not yet climbed into the line.
line.decision.speaker: Konstantinos Davakis
line.decision.text: Commander, do I send that battalion to Vovousa, or keep it below the ridge for the first real break?
line.decision.choice.hold-the-ridge-line: Fortify Vovousa and join every strongpoint into one line.
Give infantry and artillery 10 experience and fully rearm the core.
line.decision.choice.keep-a-mobile-reser: Hold Vovousa lightly and form a mobile mountain reserve.
Give reconnaissance formations 15 experience and fully refuel the core.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-a-0.text: So there is no reserve. Say it plainly; the company commanders deserve to know that the next runner brings ammunition, not relief.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Konstantinos Davakis
line.choice-a-1.text: They will know. Vovousa holds, the posts touch, and nobody invents a private withdrawal because the telephone goes quiet. Get the wire party moving.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.choice-b-0.text: A light line may bend before the reserve reaches it. I want withdrawal marks on every company map, not a general instruction to use judgment.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Konstantinos Davakis
line.choice-b-1.text: Mark them. The battalion waits under cover with loaded mules. When the Italians show us which gap matters, it goes there whole.
